title: VoxelSBFL: Voxel-Level Spectrum-Based Failure Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.22453v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate visual perception, language understanding, and action generation to control robots. Testing these systems produces trajectories and task outcomes, but existing approaches provide limited guidance on using these recorded trajectories to assess subsequent executions or inform policy repair. We conjecture that, for a given policy and task, traversing certain workspace regions is associated with a higher likelihood of failure. To investigate this conjecture, we propose VoxelSBFL, a black-box adaptation of Spectrum-Based Fault Localization (SBFL) in which workspace voxels replace program elements as units of analysis. Recorded tool-center-point (TCP) trajectories provide binary voxel coverage, which is combined with execution outcomes to construct suspiciousness maps using established SBFL formulas. translated_title: VoxelSBFL：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的体素级基于频谱的失败预测方法
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型集成了视觉感知、语言理解和动作生成能力来控制机器人。对这类系统进行测试会产生轨迹和任务结果，但现有方法对于如何利用这些记录的轨迹来评估后续执行或指导策略修复提供的指导十分有限。我们推测，对于给定的策略和任务，穿越某些工作空间区域与更高的失败可能性相关。为了验证这一猜想，我们提出了VoxelSBFL，这是基于频谱的故障定位技术的一种黑盒适配方案，其中工作空间体素取代程序元素作为分析单元。记录的工具中心点（TCP）轨迹提供二值化的体素覆盖信息，再结合执行结果，利用成熟的SBFL公式构建可疑度地图。这些地图能够识别与失败相关的区域，并为未见过的轨迹进行评分，而无需访问模型内部信息。
tldr: 该论文提出VoxelSBFL，创新性地将软件工程中的频谱故障定位（SBFL）技术黑盒迁移到机器人测试领域，以工作空间体素取代程序元素作为分析单元，利用TCP轨迹的体素覆盖信息与执行结果构建可疑度地图，从而在无需模型内部信息的情况下实现体素级的失败预测。
